name: Get Machine Info
description: Collects current machine/system information and exports it to config variables
author: Kontango Limited

config.description: Updated configuration file path with machine info variables (for chaining actions)

config_schema.description: Configuration file validation - no required fields, all machine info is collected automatically
config_schema.note: This action collects machine info and exports it - no input config fields required

exported_variables.description: Variables exported by this action (available in config after execution)

fields.MACHINE_DISK_AVAILABLE: Available disk space on root partition

dependencies.description: System packages required (most are standard on all Unix-like systems)
dependencies.note: Uses standard Unix utilities available on all systems

github.example:
- name: Get Machine Info
  uses: KontangoOSS/KONOSS/OPS/actions/get-machine-info@main
  with:
    config: machine-info.env

local.example:
- name: Get Machine Info
  uses: ./OPS/actions/get-machine-info
  with:
    config: machine-info.env

chaining.description: Collect machine info then use in another action
chaining.example:
- name: Get Machine Info
  id: machine
  uses: KontangoOSS/KONOSS/OPS/actions/get-machine-info@main
  with:
    config: .env

- name: Use Machine Info
  uses: KontangoOSS/KONOSS/OPS/actions/some-other-action@main
  with:
    config: ${{ steps.machine.outputs.config }}

standalone.description: Just collect info without config file

self_contained.description: Checklist to ensure action is completely self-contained and reusable
checklist: All scripts copied to scripts/ folder
No external dependencies beyond standard Unix utilities
All dependencies listed in dependencies.packages array
Action works when folder is copied standalone

notes: This action collects machine information and exports it as environment variables
No input configuration required - all data is collected automatically
All collected variables are saved to the config file for use in later actions
Works on Linux and macOS (with graceful fallbacks)
IP address detection attempts multiple methods for compatibility
Memory info may be 'unknown' on some systems if not available
